gloss: endlessly; as far as the eye can see; thoroughly; to the very end

definitions.gloss: endlessly; on and on; as far as one can see
definitions.explanation: Of space or a continuing scene: extending without any visible limit. Typically used of roads, skies, fields, and the sea.

definitions.gloss: thoroughly; to the very end; utterly
definitions.explanation: Of attitude or degree: refusing to stop or compromise, or being something completely. Often carries admiration or exasperation, depending on context.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧どこまでも⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The road goes on and on.

examples.japanese: どこまでも⟦{青|あお}い→青い：00586_aoi⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっていた→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: An endlessly blue sky stretched out above.

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、どこまでも⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっていた→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: Outside the window, fields stretched away as far as the eye could see.

examples.japanese: どこまでも{優|やさ}しい⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
examples.english: He is kind through and through.

examples.english: She refused to bend her opinion, no matter what.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧どこまでも⟦{正直|しょうじき}→正直：01562_shoujiki⟧で、⟦{損|そん}をする→損をする：30214_sonwosuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{分|わ}かっていて→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{嘘|うそ}をつかない→嘘をつく：21763_usowotsuku⟧。
examples.english: He is honest to the core; he won't lie even when he knows it will cost him.

notes:
Composed of ⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧ (where) + ⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧ (up to) + ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (even). The literal "even to wherever" underlies both senses: unlimited extent in space, and refusal to stop short in attitude.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- どこまでも⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: to stretch on endlessly
- どこまでも⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧: to spread out without limit
- どこまでも⟦{追|お}いかける→追いかける：16734_oikakeru⟧: to chase someone to the ends of the earth
- どこまでも⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧らしい: utterly true to oneself

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦いつ→いつ：00536_itsu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: forever — the same shape applied to time rather than space
- ⟦{徹底的|てっていてき}→徹底的：06827_tetteiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: thoroughly — sense 2 only, and more clinical
- ⟦あくまで→あくまで：06713_akumade⟧: to the last; persistently — close to sense 2, but stresses sticking to a stated position
